metadata.description: Themed packs of Claude Skills (Agent Skills) for Claude Code and Claude.ai. Each pack is an installable plugin bundling SKILL.md skills and shared reference files around one job to be done.

plugins.name: workshop-pack
plugins.description: 7 Claude Skills for running workshops that produce decisions: intention framing, agenda design, pre-work emails, facilitator run sheet, live capture of post-it walls, 48-hour synthesis, and the facilitation retro.

plugins.name: review-cycle-pack
plugins.description: 11 Claude Skills that run an annual performance review cycle without performance software: cycle planning, growth matrix, review forms, self-reviews, manager growth memos, 1:1 prep, and the end-of-cycle retro.

plugins.name: design-thinking-pack
plugins.description: 33 Claude Skills that carry a design project from a fuzzy challenge to a tested, decision-ready concept: challenge framing, interview guides and screeners, transcript synthesis, personas and journeys, HMWs and concept cards, prototype and test plans, and the stakeholder playback.

plugins.name: onboarding-pack
plugins.description: 12 Claude Skills that carry a new hire from "yes" to day 90: the pre-boarding plan, the internal setup emails for IT and finance, the cultural brief, the welcome pack, the per-joiner checklist and dashboard, the team deck, the intro email, the first goals, the first week, and the joiner's own 90-day companion.

plugins.name: design-sprint-pack
plugins.description: 13 Claude Skills for selling, running, and landing a design sprint: qualifying the ask, framing the challenge, casting the room, recruiting five testers, running map, target, sketch, decision, storyboard, prototype and Friday's interviews, and landing it on the Monday after.

plugins.name: designops-pack
plugins.description: 12 Claude Skills for making the invisible ops of a design team explicit and runnable: mapping how the team works today, then writing the critique ritual, the handoff standard, design-system governance, file conventions, request intake, the capacity plan, a new designer's onboarding, and the handbook that holds them all.

plugins.name: innovation-pack
plugins.description: 12 Claude Skills for running an innovation program that tests real bets, kills most of them cheaply, and earns its next round of funding: chartering the program, designing gates that ask questions instead of handing out scores, keeping the innovation ledger, mapping the portfolio, framing challenges, running ideation, planning the discovery interviews, designing and reading experiments, preparing each gate review, writing the case for continued investment, and closing initiatives with dignity.

plugins.name: employer-branding-pack
plugins.description: 12 Claude Skills for an employer brand a joiner's first week does not disprove: the listening round, the peer-claims map, the evidence base, the EVP as Give and Get pairs, the careers page, the job ad, the realistic preview, a colleague's own post, a quarter of hiring content, measures that work at six hires a year, the first-weeks promise check, and the quarterly review.

plugins.name: case-study-factory-pack
plugins.description: 10 Claude Skills for turning one thirty-minute interview about a delivered project into a case study in every format: the source file, the short web case, the long read, the one-pager and two-pager as real PowerPoint files, the credentials slide, the LinkedIn posts, the award entry, the proposal paragraph, and the video script.

plugins.name: proposals-pack
plugins.description: 12 Claude Skills for writing a proposal deck the client can decide from, section by section, from an RFP or from your team's own notes, ending in a .pptx: the firm context file, the brief, the storyline as action titles, the context, market, problem, vision, approach, team and investment sections, the deck build, and the review from the client's chair.

plugins.name: creative-futurology-pack
plugins.description: 12 Claude Skills for turning signals of change into scenarios and scenarios into decisions: the focal question, the sourced signal scan, the trend synthesis, the uncertainty map, three or four constructed futures, the artifacts that make them tangible, the strategy wind tunnel, the roadmap of moves, the signposts, the publishable trend report, the scenario workshop, and the leadership playback.

plugins.name: compassionate-leadership-pack
plugins.description: 20 practical skills for compassionate leadership: feedback, conflict, workload, grief, change, exits, and more human workplaces. Includes portable prompts for ChatGPT and other assistants.

plugins.name: employee-experience-pack
plugins.description: Listen to employees, find friction in the work, and turn feedback into changes people can see.

plugins.name: team-performance-pack
plugins.description: Run useful retrospectives, agree team norms, and improve coordination in everyday work.

plugins.name: stakeholder-relationships-pack
plugins.description: Understand recurring stakeholder friction, prepare a repair conversation, and agree a more workable relationship.

plugins.name: failures-and-mistakes-pack
plugins.description: Respond to mistakes, understand what happened, take responsibility, and test changes that reduce repeat failures.

plugins.name: delegation-pack
plugins.description: Choose what to delegate, agree outcomes and decision rights, and support progress without taking the work back.

plugins.name: ways-of-working-change-pack
plugins.description: Define a behavior change, understand barriers, involve the team, and learn from a practical pilot.

plugins.name: disagreements-pack
plugins.description: Clarify a disagreement, understand the other view, test options, and reach a decision people can work with.

plugins.name: top-priorities-pack
plugins.description: Clarify priorities, confront capacity, protect focused time, and renegotiate commitments.

plugins.name: important-decisions-pack
plugins.description: Frame a consequential choice, compare options, challenge assumptions, and record what would change your mind.

plugins.name: ai-psychological-safety-pack
plugins.description: Clarify a concern, question a proposed decision, rehearse speaking up, invite disagreement, prepare a response, and follow through. Includes portable prompts.

plugins.name: ai-for-customer-service-pack
plugins.description: 32 skills for running a support desk, from the hard reply to the bot handoff: hard conversations, workload and staffing, roles, metrics and coaching, escalations and incidents, learning from tickets, answers and knowledge, service design, and AI and bots, safely.

plugins.name: ai-for-hr-pack
plugins.description: 32 skills for running HR as a clear, fair process, from complaints and investigations to leave, pay bands and the handbook: the HR desk, complaints and investigations, performance and discipline, leave and absence, pay and levels, policies and the handbook, stay and leave, and join.

plugins.name: ai-for-managers-pack
plugins.description: 31 skills for running a team, from the first 1:1 to the hard conversation: the hard conversation, stepping into the role, delegating and letting go, protecting the team's capacity, managing up and through change, the team's rhythm, setting direction, and coaching and growing people.

plugins.name: ai-for-product-management-pack
plugins.description: 31 skills for deciding what to build, what to drop and whether it worked: prioritising and saying no, setting direction, discovering what customers need, defining the work, deciding and aligning, launching, and measuring and learning.

plugins.name: ai-for-project-management-pack
plugins.description: 31 skills for running a project from charter to clean handover: starting the project, stopping scope creep, estimating and scheduling, catching risks early, getting decisions made, running the delivery rhythm, reporting honestly, and closing well.

plugins.name: ai-for-recruiting-pack
plugins.description: 31 skills for recruiting from the intake meeting to the signed offer, in-house and on the agency desk: briefing the role, keeping candidates in the loop, attracting applicants, sourcing and reaching out, screening and interviewing on the same criteria for everyone, deciding and closing, the agency desk, and running the desk.

plugins.name: ai-for-training-pack
plugins.description: 30 skills for L&D and corporate training, from the first training request to proof of what changed: finding the real need, getting it out of the experts, designing the programme, building the materials, delivering it live, making it stick, proving what changed, and running the L&D desk.

plugins.name: docs-for-product-managers-pack
plugins.description: 41 skills for the documents product people write, from the first brief to the post-launch review: setting up your voice and templates, discovering, shaping the vision, defining the work, deciding, aligning, reporting up, shipping and learning, running the team, and reviewing and editing. Each skill produces one finished document with a named reader and a length budget.

plugins.name: ai-product-managers-pack
plugins.description: 36 skills for deciding if AI fits, testing it before launch and keeping it honest after: deciding if AI fits, speccing it as tests, briefing the model and the agent, building the evals from real outputs, shipping it safely, running and improving it, and its cost, price and explanation to leaders. Each skill is one named method or one artifact, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks and a fixed output template.

plugins.name: opus-for-product-managers-pack
plugins.description: 39 skills for running the whole product cycle with Claude, in seven phases that each hand a named artifact to the next: set Claude up and connect it, frame the question, discover the evidence, decide, build and ship, communicate the call and run the week. Each skill teaches one named, checkable method, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks, a fixed output template and the next skill to run.

plugins.name: slides-for-product-managers-pack
plugins.description: 32 skills for every deck a product person makes, drafted in Claude Slides from your own sources, in six groups: start every deck (the deck context file and its metric dictionary, the slide design system, the deck brief naming the decider and the ask, the ghost deck of action titles, doc to deck, one master cut per audience), the decks for leaders, the updates for everyone, the team decks, the decks for customers and the market, and the passes that make a deck hold up. Each skill is one deck type or one deck method, with its inputs, where it breaks, a fixed output template, a finish line and the next skill to run.

plugins.name: complete-claude-guide-for-product-managers-pack
plugins.description: 42 skills for the whole product job, stage by stage, from the vision to the weekly update, in eight stages: set direction, discover, decide, define, deliver, launch, prove, and run the product. Each skill is named as an action and keeps one framework inside, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks, a fixed output template, a finish line and the next skill to run.

plugins.name: grad-business-pack
plugins.description: 31 skills for doing the work a business graduate is hired for, in seven stages: get AI-fluent for work, research the business, analyse the numbers, write for busy people, present it, build a proof project, and show it to employers. Each skill is one named method or one artifact, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks, a fixed output template, a finish line and the next skill to run.

plugins.name: grad-first-job-pack
plugins.description: 31 skills for getting up to speed in your first job, in seven stages: before day one, AI at work safely, learn fast, your first 30, 60 and 90 days, do the work well, feedback and progress, and the habits that compound. Each skill is one named method or one artifact, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks, a fixed output template, a finish line and the next skill to run.

plugins.name: grad-linkedin-pack
plugins.description: 28 skills for an honest LinkedIn presence in your own voice, in seven stages: know your story, build the profile, show your proof of work, post as a graduate, comment and connect, be found by recruiters and alumni, and the weekly 20 minutes. Each skill is one named method or one artifact, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks, a fixed output template, a finish line and the next skill to run.

plugins.name: grad-marketing-pack
plugins.description: 31 skills for doing the junior marketing job well with Claude and then showing it, in seven stages: set up AI-fluent marketing work, research the audience and market, plan the campaign, create content in the brand voice, report and improve, build a proof project, and apply and interview. Each skill is one named method or one artifact, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks, a fixed output template, a finish line and the next skill to run.
